name: nightly-eval-compounding
goal: Re-run the CI-triage eval suite against the latest skills. For any newly-failing case, investigate and append the confirmed failure mode to the ci-triage skill; update STATE.md with what changed.
rubric: Every eval case was run; new failure modes (if any) were written into skills/ci-triage.md; STATE.md last-session was updated.

name: nightly-reflection
goal: Reflect on the open failures and lessons accumulated in STATE.md. Distill durable general rules and concrete skill failure-modes, and write them back so future runs inherit them.
rubric: New general rules and/or skill failure-modes were distilled from accumulated failures and written to memory.

name: ci-failure-triage
goal: A CI run just failed. Read the latest logs in workspace/ci-latest.log, classify the failure using the ci-triage skill, draft a fix for tractable cases, and escalate the rest in STATE.md.
rubric: Failure classified; a fix drafted or a clear escalation recorded in STATE.md.
